projects.name: AI-Powered Note Manager
projects.description: A smart AI-powered note-taking application built with Next.js featuring rich text editing, AI commands, organization, and intelligent search.
projects.summary: A scalable Next.js application for managing notes with AI-powered summaries, tags, folders, and advanced search. Built with a clean service-based architecture.
highlights: Rich text editing powered by Tiptap with block-style editor experience
AI commands directly inside editor using slash (/) commands
Drag-and-drop image support with Base64 storage
Smart organization using folders and custom tags
Authentication with NextAuth Google and GitHub providers

details.title: Core Features
bullets: Rich text editor with Markdown-like shortcuts
AI-powered writing assistance through editor commands
Media upload and instant image saving

details.title: Authentication
details.body: Secure authentication system implemented using NextAuth.js with Google and GitHub OAuth providers.

details.title: Database
details.body: MongoDB with Mongoose provides scalable and reliable data storage for user notes, categories, and metadata.

details.title: Architecture
details.body: Built using Next.js App Router with a clean service-based architecture, optimized for scalability and maintainability.

projects.name: DevTrack
projects.description: A personal developer activity tracker that helps build consistent coding habits with Pomodoro sessions, productivity tracking, and developer-focused analytics.
projects.summary: DevTrack is a developer productivity platform built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. It helps developers track focused coding sessions, maintain streaks, and analyze productivity through Pomodoro-based workflows.
highlights: Pomodoro timer with document title synchronization and session controls
Session logging with duration, tags, and personal notes
Developer streak tracking with productivity visualization
Customizable focus environment with wallpaper selector
Animated landing page using GSAP and Motion

details.title: Productivity Features
bullets: Built-in Pomodoro timer for focused coding sessions
Track coding activity with detailed session logs

details.title: Authentication
details.body: Secure login system implemented with NextAuth v4 and Google OAuth, allowing users to access their personalized productivity dashboard.

details.title: Database Architecture
details.body: Uses PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for structured data management, including users, sessions, and productivity records.

details.title: Frontend Experience
bullets: Smooth animations using GSAP and Motion

details.title: Development Setup
details.body: Docker Compose support provides an easy local PostgreSQL setup with Prisma database workflows.

projects.name: QuickChat
projects.description: A full-stack real-time chat application with secure authentication, live messaging, profile management, and media sharing capabilities.
projects.summary: QuickChat is a MERN-based real-time messaging platform built with React, Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and MongoDB. It enables instant communication with secure authentication, profile management, and media sharing.
highlights: Responsive React interface with Tailwind CSS

details.title: Real-Time Communication
bullets: Instant messaging using WebSocket communication with Socket.IO
Live chat updates without page refresh

details.title: Authentication & Security
details.body: Implemented JWT-based authentication with secure user sessions and protected API routes.

details.title: Media Management
details.body: Integrated Cloudinary for efficient image and media uploads, enabling users to share content seamlessly.

details.title: Architecture
bullets: MongoDB with Mongoose for database management

details.title: Deployment
details.body: Configured production deployment with separate frontend and backend services, including environment-based configuration.
